name: maoxian-web-clipper
description: A web extension to clip information from web page. Save it to your local machine to avoid information invalidation. Not bored registration, Not charged.

scripts.build-chromium-production: cross-env NODE_ENV=production MX_PLATFORM=chromium MX_PLATFORM_ID=$MX_CHROMIUM_ID MX_PLATFORM_UPDATE_URL=$MX_CHROMIUM_UPDATE_URL_MV3 node build.js
scripts.build-firefox-production: cross-env NODE_ENV=production MX_PLATFORM=firefox MX_PLATFORM_ID=$MX_FIREFOX_ID node build.js
scripts.build-all-production: npm run build-chromium && npm run build-firefox
scripts.sep1: Belowing scripts are for the laze people
scripts.comment-ignore-me_autoload: Start the browser with a temporary profile, and auto reload the extension
scripts.comment-ignore-me_juststart: Only start the browser with a temporary profile, without auto reload the exension

author: Mika
